about.title: A little bit about me
about.text:
I am a Junior Software Developer with a focus on backend development using Java and Spring Boot, combined with modern frontend technologies like React.

I enjoy building fullstack applications and understanding how systems work end-to-end — from API design and database integration to deployment using Docker and CI/CD pipelines.

My current tech stack includes:
- Java (Spring Boot)
- React
- PostgreSQL / MongoDB
- Docker & Docker Compose
- Testing with JUnit, Mockito, and Jest

Outside of coding, I spend most of my time working on personal projects and continuously improving my skills. I also train in martial arts and strength training, which helps me stay disciplined and focused.
